meaning: The fully instrumented control mounted successfully, so no variant result is informative. Per the runner's own contract this is inconclusive, not a fix.
established: Instrumentation is not the cause. All six profiles, in both orders, mounted in 788-1878ms — including both full-instrumentation controls with network diagnostics, console observer, response summary and checkpoint writes all enabled.
constantDifference: This runner reuses an existing fixture; the failing editing harness imports a new one each run. That difference was held constant across all twelve trials and is now the leading candidate — but it is not established, because a direct probe that also imported a fresh project reached ready in about 5s.
nextExperiment: Vary fixture freshness rather than instrumentation: run the same paired comparison with a new import per trial. Neither instrumentation alone nor fresh import alone has reproduced the failure.
